elements.requirement: A person commits an offence if that person is in breach of a non-harassment order made under section 8 or section 8A.
elements.quote: in breach of a non-harassment order made under section 8 or section 8A is guilty of an offence

elements.requirement: A person convicted on indictment of breaching a non-harassment order made under section 8 or section 8A is liable to imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years, to a fine, or to both.
elements.quote: on conviction on indictment, to imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years or to a fine, or to both

elements.requirement: A person convicted summarily of breaching a non-harassment order made under section 8 or section 8A is liable to imprisonment for a period not exceeding six months, to a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum, or to both.
elements.quote: on summary conviction, to imprisonment for a period not exceeding six months or to a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum, or to both

elements.requirement: A breach of a non-harassment order is not punishable in any way other than in accordance with subsection (1).
elements.quote: shall not be punishable other than in accordance with subsection (1)

elements.requirement: A constable is permitted to arrest without warrant any person whom the constable reasonably believes is committing or has committed an offence of breaching a non-harassment order.
elements.quote: A constable may arrest without warrant any person he reasonably believes is committing or has committed an offence

elements.requirement: The constable's power of arrest without warrant under subsection (3) does not prejudice any other power of arrest conferred by law.
elements.quote: without prejudice to any power of arrest conferred by law apart from that subsection

thresholds.what: maximum term of imprisonment on conviction on indictment
